content.title: QUICK {{FIXES}} FOR EVERYDAY BODY GLITCHES
facts: Hiccups – Swallow a spoonful of **sugar** to interrupt the reflex signal to your diaphragm.
Bad Breath – Chew a sprig of **parsley**; its chlorophyll helps neutralize sulfur compounds.
Chapped Lips – Dab on a little **honey** to seal in moisture and calm cracked skin.
Nosebleed – Pinch the **soft part** of your nose and lean forward, not back, for a minute.
Canker Sores – Rinse with **warm salt water** a few times a day to ease irritation.
Foot Cramps – Press your **heel** into the floor and pull your toes upward to release the muscle.
Hay Fever – Rinse your sinuses with a **saline spray** to flush out pollen and dust.
Splinter – Soak the spot in **warm water with baking soda** to help it work its way out.
